statement: Let C be a smooth projective complex curve of genus g ≥ 2, let n ≥ 2 and d be coprime integers, and let L ∈ Picd (C). For the moduli space X of stable rank-n, determinant-L, trace-free Higgs bundles and its corresponding twisted SLn character variety XB, nonabelian Hodge theory identifies PkHm (X, Q) = W2kHm (XB , Q) = W2k+1Hm (XB , Q) for all integers m, k. The equality holds on full rational cohomology, including its Pic0 (C)[n]-variant part.
